releases.headline: Sequence solver set discovery fixes
releases.summary: Restores unfinished nonrepeatable SBCs in the sequence planner and fixes related challenge-fetch and completion checks.
details: Unfinished nonrepeatable SBCs now appear in the Single Challenge and Entire Set selectors. FC27's zero repeat counter no longer incorrectly marks them as exhausted.
Completed nonrepeatable sets and exhausted limited-repeatable sets remain excluded. Refreshing the catalog removes newly completed sets.
Set and sequence solvers now share the challenge-fetch helper, fixing sequence fetching when no challenge cache is available.
Submitting one squad no longer closes an unfinished nonrepeatable set because of its zero repeat counter.
Added six sequence discovery, compatibility, refresh, challenge-fetch and completion regressions to the release gate.

releases.headline: Solver, concept buyer and price reliability fixes
releases.summary: Fixes defects found during the FC27 release review and adds regression checks before packaging.
details: Empty or undersized player pools no longer produce false solved squads, and unsupported requirements are rejected even when filtering leaves no players.
EA-locked players remain protected through rating refinement, chemistry optimization and duplicate replacement.
Stopping the concept buyer during a search prevents a subsequent bid. Late price results cannot reset Bought or Owned rows.
A purchased player remains Bought if its club move fails, with a pending-move message. Failed squad-apply pile moves now stop with the EA error.
Successful automated SBC submissions remove spent item IDs from recent-purchase recovery while retaining unspent copies.
Large price requests share decoded console or PC CDN data and no longer use retired per-ID price pacing. Temporary failures can be retried, and malformed empty blobs are rejected and refetched.
Opening Autopilot settings selects the current tab bar after EA recreates its navigation.
Repackaging clears obsolete files from the versioned destination. The release workflow now runs solver, buyer, settings, pricing, points and packaging regression tests before building.

releases.headline: FC27 solvers and a dedicated Autopilot tab
releases.summary: Adds points SBC solving, the approved settings tab, EA exclusion icons and the FC27 solver repairs.
details: Restored Solve Squad clicks and updated FC27 inventory, unassigned, transfer-list, response, requirement and reward hooks.
Added Solve Points using EA eligibility and item scores. Continue through EA Review Selection; automatic points submission through set and sequence solving is not supported.
Added a native Autopilot tab with Player pool, Card types and Exclusions pages, rating sliders and presets, all seven options, Save, Discard and Reset.
Added official EA league badges and nation flags. Embedded styles prevent an unstyled opening flash and remain isolated from the host app.
Challenge settings, Multi Solve and sequence steps now use Bronze, Silver and Gold choices, with compatible saved preferences.
Updated FC27 concept data and console/PC CDN prices, improved concept purchase recovery and owned-player refinement, and included the required worker modules.
Fixed maximum squad rating validation, including Room To Grow, while keeping minimum and exact rating requirements intact.
Updated packaging to include every runtime module. Settings-script failures no longer prevent solver startup.

releases.headline: FC27 quality choices in every solver panel
releases.summary: Challenge settings, Multi Solve and sequence steps now use Bronze, Silver and Gold choices.
details: Replaced the six legacy Common/Rare pickers with three quality tiles, matching the Autopilot tab.
Existing preferences remain readable. Selecting a quality enables both compatible stored bucket keys.
Solve summaries use quality names, and each panel keeps at least one quality enabled.

releases.headline: Maximum squad rating requirements fixed
releases.summary: The squad solver accepts valid bronze squads below a maximum rating, including Room To Grow.
details: Maximum team-rating requirements no longer trigger rating improvement or incorrect rating-shortfall diagnostics.
Validation respects minimum, maximum and exact ratings, including separate lower and upper bounds.

releases.headline: EA nation flags in exclusions
releases.summary: Nation exclusions now show EA's official country and region flags.
details: Flag URLs come from EA's current asset helper and nation IDs, with their original proportions.
Nation and league icons share lazy loading and a fallback for unavailable assets.

releases.headline: EA league badges in exclusions
releases.summary: League exclusions show the same official badges as the transfer-market selector.
details: League badge URLs come from EA's current asset helper and league IDs, including its dark theme variant.
Badges preserve their proportions and transparent backgrounds. Unavailable assets use a fallback without repeated failed requests.

releases.headline: Settings open without an unstyled flash
releases.summary: The full settings stylesheet is available before the Autopilot tab opens.
details: Styles ship with the settings controls and are inserted synchronously in the detached shadow root before the view is displayed.
Opening the tab no longer requests a separate stylesheet or switches through a loading overlay.

releases.headline: A dedicated Autopilot settings tab
releases.summary: Manage global solver defaults from the new Autopilot tab in the FC web app.
details: Added Player pool, Card types and Exclusions pages using the approved settings design.
Connected Save, Discard, Reset, rating presets, all seven pool toggles and real EA league, nation and player exclusions to existing preferences.
Global settings moved out of EA Settings. Challenge, multi, set and points solver controls keep their existing workflows.
Native navigation preserves other extension tabs. Styles are isolated from EA and other extensions.

releases.headline: Points SBCs and FC27 concept data
releases.summary: Added Solve Points in the native Work Area and repaired FC27 concept catalog and prices.
details: Solve Points searches EA-eligible owned players, uses EA item scores, respects solver filters and the native selection limit, and preserves existing selections.
Points selections continue through EA Review Selection and its score submission flow. Automatic set and sequence submission of points SBCs is not supported.
Updated concept player data to FC27 and replaced the retired price API with current console and PC CDN prices.
Added the missing concept module to worker resources and guardrails against unsupported SBC requirements.

releases.headline: FC27 web app hook fixes
releases.summary: Restored Solve Squad clicks and updated FC27 inventory and reward hooks.
details: Fixed Solve Squad inheriting the disabled state of EA's Exchange Players button.
Updated transfer list and unassigned item fetching to use FC27's current services.
Updated item pile and SBC requirement enum lookup to use EA's current runtime values.
Fixed response payload handling and updated reward dialog detection.

releases.headline: FC27 price and transfer list fixes
releases.summary: Player prices and your transfer list now read correctly on the FC27 Web App.
details: Fixed player prices so they use the FC27 price data set instead of last season's.
Fixed reading your transfer list, which came back empty on FC27.
Cleaned up the transfer list lookup so it falls back safely when a Web App build changes its data shape.

releases.headline: FC27 support
releases.summary: AutopilotSBC now works on the FC27 Web App.
details: Updated the extension for the FC27 Web App.
Fixed player fetching, which returned no players because of a change in how EA returns club and item data.
Fixed challenge and set images so they load from the current FC content path.
Updated the extension name and description to FC27.

releases.headline: Smarter solver efficiency and card type controls.
releases.summary: Improved solver efficiency and added clearer control over which card types the solver can use.
details: Added solved squad player pricing.
Improved solver efficiency so it should use less high rated player anchors.
Added card type pickers to the single, multi, and sequence solvers.

releases.headline: Improved sequence solver panel and solving algorithm.
releases.summary: Added a review before submit mode as an option in the sequence solver.
details: Added a review before submit mode as an option in the sequence solver.
improved sequence solvers algorthim to deal with complex chem challenges.

releases.headline: Improved fetching speeds.
releases.summary: Made player fetching much more efficient and take less time.
details: Made player fetching much more efficient and take less time.
Minor imrpovement to solver logic to fix a small regression.

releases.headline: TOTS solver fix

details: Improved solver logic to recognise TOTS requirements and club players.
Added a button to quickly view the extensions source code in the global settings menu.

releases.headline: Solver and player pool fixes
releases.summary: Improved solver logic and fixed the SBC Storage and Use Unassigned settings.
details: Improved solver logic so it handles SBCs more reliably.
Fixed Only Storage so it properly uses players that match your SBC storage.
Fixed Use Unassigned so unassigned players can be fetched, solved with, and applied correctly.

details: Added a better fallback flow so the solver recovers more reliably solve difficult challenges.
Improved player fetching to allow for more intelligent triggers.
Made small UI improvements and cleanup tweaks.

releases.headline: Sequence Solver fixes

Progress now updates during active solve phases.
Improved handling for refreshed or relisted SBC challenges.
Fixed the missing Sequence Solver button bug in the SBC tab.

releases.headline: Better sequence runs and easier solver control
releases.summary: Made Sequence Solver easier to follow and added more control over who the solver can use.
details: Sequence Solver now shows the exact players used for each completed challenge.
Sequence Solver now lets you flip through completed challenge entries inside the execution panel.
Added local league and nation exclusions so you can block or allow them for a specific solve without changing your global settings.
TOTW cards can now be controlled separately from the main special-card filter.
Fixed exclusion panels so they show the right blocked items, stay in sync, and scroll properly.
